title: The two funniest lines, re-rolled after both were binned on scale
why: Of the twelve images in wordings-01, six came back with the sign past the arm line. The two that lost were THE GARDEN TAVERN and DAD'S BAR - the best-reading wordings of the six. Max approved a 4-credit re-roll on 30 Jul.
what_changed_from_wordings_01: A second, concrete size comparator was added next to the arm-line rule: 'the sign's full length is about the same as the distance from his chin down to his waistband'. The arm line is a relationship between two things the model renders; the chin-to-waist line is a measurement against a body it has already placed.
THE HOLD was moved into image 2's role list explicitly, so the diagonal comes off the reference rather than off a sentence about the camera.
Room plate F was switched from take-03 (a reject - shutter rendered closed) to take-01.
result: 4 of 4 held the size rule. wordings-01 was 6 of 12. One batch is not proof, but the chin-to-waist comparator is the only variable that changed for the garden concept, and it is cheap to keep.

outputs.agent_qc: PICK - both ends fall inside his arms, diagonal reads as a casual hold, wording fully legible
candidate - usable, but the sign is a touch longer and the left end sits on the arm line rather than inside it
candidate - the hold came back nearly level, so the angle Max approved is lost and the left end runs past his arm
PICK - steepest diagonal of the four and the closest to the approved hold, both hands correctly formed, shutter open with the yard visible
